title: Area
description: A part of the project with an owner (design part 3.2). Areas live in policy.json under rights.areas, so they carry no schema_version of their own. Reliability is derived and the review rate is controller-set; neither is stored here.

invariants.description: A pointer into the knowledge base.

may_decide.description: The rule bases this area's owners may decide (design part 4.5). Anything not listed stays with the owner.
